ri.title: Physical assumption violated on USB
ri.desc: Physical or side-channel access at USB defeats a protection the product assumes the environment provides.
ri.risk: A USB device plugged in by anyone with access to the cabinet could change the gateway's logic or firmware and disturb the plant.

cu.title: Reduce: Physical on USB
cu.desc: The operator must act so that: Physical or side-channel access at USB defeats a protection the product assumes the environment provides.

sp.title: Provenance protection on Cloud/API
sp.desc: Product control addressing: A component, update, or peer delivered via Cloud/API is not from the source the product assumes (supply-chain / substitution).
